Clothes.description:
Thanks for visiting our store! We are a small, family-owned business in Indiana working to raise money on eBay to support our up-and-coming small homestead and family farm. We are Tim and Rachel, and we sell on eBay to work towards our goals and raise our seven children. Thanks for shopping with us! 

The details for all of our items can be found in the pictures, and in the little condition description box above this full description box. There you can find needed details.

We aim to ship promptly on Monday - Thursday. Returns are accepted within 30 days. Buyer pays return shipping. If for any reason not mentioned in the description you are unhappy with your item, please reach out to us and let us help in any way we can. 

Thanks again for shopping with us and have a blessed day!

Tim and Rachel
Bringing Life Homestead
